summary: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K to submit its 2026 annual report to the Korea Exchange (KRX) as required by KRX listing rules. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure of consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. It does not involve any special situation such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other corporate event. The filing contains no deal terms, recommendations, or advisory appointments. It is a standard compliance submission for a foreign private issuer maintaining a dual listing on KRX. There are no actionable catalysts or risk-arb angles.
